description: Evaluation dataset for agent-rs retrieval quality against Cognee baseline. Uses the Romanian Penal Code (test.pdf) as the document, but question TYPES are generic and can be applied to any domain.

questions.question: Ce prevede articolul 170 din Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Direct article lookup — retrieval should return article 170 at top rank.

questions.question: Ce prevede articolul 228 Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Direct article lookup for theft definition.

questions.question: articolul 170
questions.notes: Pure keyword/number lookup. Lexical should shine.

questions.question: Ce se intampla daca fur si bat o persoana?
questions.notes: Conceptual / semantic — should map to robbery (talharie = theft+violence).

questions.question: Cum este pedepsita uciderea unei persoane?
questions.notes: Semantic understanding — killing maps to omor/ucidere.

questions.question: Care este diferenta dintre tentativa si infractiunea consumata?
questions.notes: Requires connecting articles on attempt vs completed offense.

questions.question: Cum se combina furtul calificat cu circumstantele agravante?
questions.notes: Multi-article reasoning across qualified theft + aggravating circumstances.

questions.question: Rezuma capitolul despre infractiuni contra patrimoniului
questions.notes: Summary-level query — should benefit from summaries index.

questions.question: Prezinta pe scurt prevederile despre infractiuni contra persoanei
questions.notes: Summary-level query over crimes against the person chapter.

questions.question: Ce modificari au intrat in vigoare in 2014?
questions.notes: Temporal / date-filtered retrieval. May return empty if no dated content.

questions.question: Ce fapte NU constituie infractiune?
questions.notes: Negation — requires understanding what is excluded. Hard for vector search.

questions.question: Care este diferenta intre furt si talharie?
questions.notes: Comparison — should retrieve both concepts and contrast them.

questions.question: Care este diferenta intre omor si ucidere din culpa?
questions.notes: Comparison between intentional and negligent killing.

questions.question: Care sunt pedepsele pentru furt calificat?
questions.notes: General concept retrieval for qualified theft penalties.
